assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Three panels, each with the downward parabola y = -x^2 - 1 and a red unit circle centred on the y-axis: for a = 0 the circle sits above the vertex and touches it at (0,-1); for a = 2 the circle touches the vertex from below and crosses the parabola at two green points (plus and minus 1, -2); for a = 9/4 the circle touches the parabola at two symmetric points.

difficulty_rationale: Needs a systematic tangency condition and the realisation that tangency can occur at the vertex (two circles) or at a symmetric pair of points.
